2026 The Meteorite Runner Preview:

1. Desert Lightning: Blinkers, back to 1200m are ticks but he looks cast.

2. Mazu: I am keen each way on Mazu. He ran in the Champions Sprint in his first run for Ciaron Maher and tried hard but tired late. Much better suited at this level, bit of rain about, and the way Cranbourne plays, up/in, he’ll take running down.

3. Arkansaw Kid: Close up in the Fisher but I think his better days are behind him.

4. Smooth Chino: Smooth Chino has been given a mini let up since his McEwen triumph, finding plenty from off speed and surged hard late to score. Has been kept on ice with this race in mind and is one of the leading contenders.

5. Ndola: Showed good grit to win the Rising Fast on Derby Day. Big win here the start prior, he seems to race best on the fresh side…I say he commands respect.

6. Charm Stone: Has class on her side but the gate does make things very tricky. If she gets luck, she’s dangerous.

7. Zou Sensation: He is here, I dare say, to tune up for The Supernova.

8. Watchme Win: Impressive winner of the Fisher and looks to be back on track. Just where does he get to from the draw.

9. Meridius: Maps to do no work and be effective late…just reckon his main goal will be The Supernova.

10. Perilous Fighter: Narrow second in the Century but that is his go, 1000m, not 1200m.

11. Inkaruna: Tries hard but just doesn’t win often enough and for mine, is up against it.

12. Jenni The Fox: Jenni The Fox was sneaky good in the Rising Fast. Back near last in the run, she was never a threat but didn’t mind the way she finished her race off in defeat. If within range, she has the finale to be dangerous.

13. Gentle Steel: Looks tested.

14. Immortal Star: Just fair in the Fisher and is outclassed here I suspect.

2026 The Meteorite Betting Strategy:

$100 Win Mazu

2026 The Meteorite Speed Map

Mazu should lead for fun. Gentle Steel likely lands box seat with Zou Sensation not being far away. Do they give Arkansaw Kid and Charm Stone a dig in the ribs from wide draws? If not, Mazu will get a comfortable lead.
